pop.nobles.desc: These represent the rich and powerful, with a lineAge that can not be doubted. This is the Pops that provide the main Characters to lead the Country.
pop.clergy.desc: The spiritual leaders of our Country, the clergy Pops constitute the group that keeps our religious traditions in check and educates our People in the mysteries of our Faith.
pop.burghers.desc: These represent the mercantile strata of the Country, economics and Finances being tHeir reign. They are based mostly in Urban Locations, where they Promote Wealth with productive Buildings.
pop.laborers.desc: These represent the People who work manual labour in our Urban Locations and Rural Locations. They work the land to create, harvest and gather the Raw Goods that are the backbone of the Country, or work as unskilled labour in Military Abilityls.
pop.soldiers.desc: These represent the common People that provide the Manpower for our Armies and Garrisons as well as Sailors for our Navies.
pop.peasants.desc: These represent the common People over whom we rule. Most of them live on subsistence farming, or in our villAges.
pop.slaves.desc: These represent dispossessed People working gathering Raw Goods or at Plantations for tHeir masters, being treated as commodities either by tHeir birth, or by acquisition in Trade Markets.
pop.tribesmen.desc: These represent commUnities that Populate Rural Locations, subsisting on tHeir Own as farmers, shepherds, or hunter-gatherers, and that we can hardly govern, since they Maintain tHeir Own differentiated social structures and organization.

field.development.desc: DevelopMent represents how cultivated the land is, and how much it is used by the Pops living there. The higher the DevelopMent, the more People can live there, and the more it can be exploited.
